title: In this town, everything you lose finds its way back to you
description:
In my town, nothing stays lost. Gloves hop after their owners up the slipway, and a kite that blows off the beach is back on its roof by dinner.

Nothing I lose ever comes back. Then my evenings started going blank, and every time I came to, I was a little further across the water, closer to the island where Gran lives.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: What would you want to find its way back to you?
